name: Mongolia
shortSummary: India describes Mongolia as a "spiritual neighbour" through shared Buddhist heritage, and has extended development financing including a line of credit for Mongolia's first oil refinery.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: India funds restoration of Buddhist heritage and provides scholarships to Mongolian monks and students.
Indian line-of-credit financing for Mongolia's refinery project.

majorChallenges.title: Landlocked geography
majorChallenges.description: Mongolia's location between Russia and China constrains the practical scope of direct bilateral trade and connectivity.

recentDevelopments.title: Continued implementation of oil refinery financing
recentDevelopments.description: Work continued on the India-financed oil refinery project in Mongolia under the 2015 line of credit.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: A long-running but steady development cooperation track, insulated from broader geopolitical shifts.

historicalEvents.title: Establishment of Diplomatic Relations
historicalEvents.description: India becomes one of the first countries outside the Soviet bloc to establish diplomatic relations with Mongolia.

historicalEvents.title: "Spiritual Neighbour" Visit
historicalEvents.description: PM Modi becomes the first Indian prime minister to visit Mongolia, extending a $1 billion line of credit including for an oil refinery.

agreements.name: Line of Credit for Mongolia Oil Refinery
agreements.description: Indian concessional financing to help Mongolia build its first domestic oil refinery.
